# Takayama Green Hotel

> > Official website for Takayama Green Hotel (Keio Group Hotels), a traditional hot spring resort in Hida Takayama featuring authentic Japanese kaiseki, Chinese cuisine, natural onsen baths, and the Hida Bussan-kan souvenir theme park with 7000+ local products.

Located in the historic Hida Takayama region of Gifu Prefecture, this hotel offers multiple accommodation wings (Sakuraryo, Tenryo), diverse dining options featuring Hida beef, and serves as a gateway to exploring local attractions including Shirakawa-go, seasonal foliage, and traditional crafts.

## Key Topics

- Takayama Green Hotel
- Hida Takayama (飛騨高山)
- Hida region (飛騨)
- Hida Takayama Onsen (飛騨高山温泉)
- Keio Group Hotels (京王グループホテルズ)
- Hida Bussan-kan (飛騨物産館)
- Hida beef (飛騨牛)
- Local specialties & souvenirs
- Shirakawa-go (白川郷)
- Japanese kaiseki cuisine
- Sarubobo dolls
- Local sake
- Seasonal foliage & cherry blossoms
- Traditional crafts & furniture
- Regional tourism
